items: Restored the cross-host offer to capture sweeping directives through latch_priority_add only with user approval.
Restored canonical promotion for fully shipped sequence plans.
Restored Cursor's exact read-only latch_pm_preview to one matching latch_insert boundary.

cursor_live_probe.effect: The CLI cannot arm a prompt hash, so the opt-in preToolUse hook fails closed on mutation even after a matching gate call.
cursor_live_probe.interpretation: This is not a compact-contract regression. Cursor IDE must be exercised separately because the headless CLI cannot prove current-prompt receipt success.

cursor_targeted_replay.current_prompt_primary: Three of three runs reached exact gate calls but performed no expected mutation because beforeSubmitPrompt did not arm state.
cursor_targeted_replay.current_prompt_secondary: One run rejected a stale echoed request and did not mutate.
cursor_targeted_replay.pm_primary: Three runs previewed but writes were hook-blocked while current-prompt state was unavailable.
cursor_targeted_replay.pm_secondary: One run previewed and correctly requested a later /latch-pm apply turn.
scoring_corrections: A missing expected mutation in a blocker case must be a hard functional failure.
The PM scenario must use two turns in one resumed Cursor session; preview and apply are intentionally not a one-turn flow.

claude.live_agent_scenarios: not run in this distribution pass

codex.live_agent_scenarios: not run in this distribution pass

cursor.live_agent_scenarios: Targeted enforcement replay completed; the CLI host limitation and invalid one-turn PM expectation are recorded under verification.

evidence: Version 2 managed documents repair once to version 3 and preserve user content.
Version 999 managed documents and Cursor rules are refused rather than downgraded.
Managed-document and Cursor-rule backups reproduce the older bytes; restoring those bytes is detected as older and safely rolls forward again.
Cursor collision and malformed-owned-hook cases stop without claiming current wiring.
update_and_rollback.limitation: Rollback is backup-based and per-file; an atomic multi-file Cursor rollback transaction is not implemented.

unverified_gaps: The complete live Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor behavioral corpus has not yet been run against isolated mainline and candidate installs.
Cursor IDE current-prompt receipt success is not proven; the current Cursor Agent CLI does not emit beforeSubmitPrompt in the tested headless path.
Cursor PM preview/apply still needs a two-turn resumed-session live test, including exact-match success, changed-argument denial, and receipt replay denial.
Longitudinal adherence and silent-failure rates are not measured, so no claim is made about degradation over time.
Rendered line and word reduction is a leading footprint indicator, not proof of lower latency, cost, or better decisions.
No Windows host lifecycle was exercised in this pass.
Existing Cursor commands, skills, and hooks were covered by lifecycle tests, but their corrected full behavioral matrix was not replayed with live model calls.
The degraded-gate behavior is not uniformly enforced outside hook-capable hosts; the deep pass must measure and report this rather than infer safety from markdown wording.
No automated alert currently detects every missed supersede, reconciliation, capture, or stop-and-show behavior.
